```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(castSDM)
```

## Paired model disagreement

Model SD is calculated after within-model paired contrasts. It is the sample
SD among active models, without weighting by ensemble weight. With one model
it is unassessed (`NA`), not zero. It is neither a sampling confidence interval
nor an ensemble-surface SD.

```{r paired}
current <- data.frame(temperature = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 12),
                      land = rep(c(.2, .8), 6), elevation = 100)
fit <- cast_as_fit(list(a = c(.8, -.3), b = c(1.2, -.1)), current,
  function(model, newdata) plogis(model[1]*newdata$temperature + model[2]*newdata$land))
future <- transform(current, temperature = temperature + .4, land = land + .1)
comparison <- cast_compare(fit, current, future,
  groups = list(climate = "temperature", land_use = "land"),
  weights = c(a = .4, b = .6), threshold = .5, verbose = FALSE)
summary(comparison)[, c("component", "mean", "mean_model_sd")]
```

Each cell uses the same positive-weight models in all corners. A changed
supplied static layer causes an error; an omitted static layer inherits
current values. `domain = "common"` intersects finite inputs across all
requested futures and the mask. `domain = "scenario"` uses separate domains.
Every active model must predict finite values on the eligible domain.

## A small raster calculation

Grids and CRS must already match. Outputs contain four predictions, eight
contrasts, eight paired SD layers and a support flag. Empty masked blocks are
skipped and current model predictions are reused across futures.

```{r raster, eval=requireNamespace("terra", quietly=TRUE)}
current_raster <- terra::rast(nrows = 3, ncols = 4, nlyrs = 3,
  xmin = 0, xmax = 4000, ymin = 0, ymax = 3000, crs = "EPSG:3857")
terra::values(current_raster) <- as.matrix(current)
names(current_raster) <- names(current)
future_raster <- terra::rast(current_raster)
terra::values(future_raster) <- as.matrix(future)
output <- tempfile("cast-vignette-")
raster_comparison <- cast_compare(fit, current_raster, future_raster,
  groups = list(climate = "temperature", land_use = "land"),
  weights = c(a = .4, b = .6), threshold = .5,
  output_dir = output, verbose = FALSE)
all.equal(raster_comparison$summary, comparison$summary)
resumed <- cast_compare(fit, current_raster, future_raster,
  groups = list(climate = "temperature", land_use = "land"),
  weights = c(a = .4, b = .6), threshold = .5,
  output_dir = output, verbose = FALSE)
resumed$events[, c("stage", "cache_hit")]
unlink(output, recursive = TRUE)
```

Binary counts use `>=` and the continuous summaries' finite domain. Counts
denote cells; area interpretation needs an equal-area grid or explicit weighting.

## Already-created surfaces and individual drivers

`cast_factorial_attribution()` computes the same eight contrasts from four
ensemble surfaces. It cannot recover paired model SD. Optional `sd_*` inputs
produce `surface_sd_*` diagnostics under an independence approximation that
ignores covariance between predictions.

```{r surfaces}
corners <- comparison$results$future$data
factorial <- cast_factorial_attribution(corners$current, corners$joint,
  corners$climate, corners$lulc, threshold = .5, verbose = FALSE)
factorial$contract
```

`cast_attribution()` optionally evaluates driver-only and retained-driver
contrasts. Driver-only changes one predictor. Retained-driver compares the
full future with a future retaining that predictor's current value. Individual
effects need not add to total change.

```{r drivers}
drivers <- cast_attribution(fit, current, future,
  drivers = c("temperature", "land"), weights = c(a = .4, b = .6), verbose = FALSE)
drivers$summary
```

Support checks marginal training quantiles on original inputs even when
predictions are clamped. It cannot establish multivariate support or ecological
transportability. Contrasts remain model-conditional.

## Resources and caches

`resources = list(cores = 8, workers = 2, memory_mb = 4096)` declares one total
budget: two scenario processes, at most four RF threads per process and blocks
derived from the memory allowance. `scratch_dir` must be an existing writable
directory. Workers require an installed matching package. Additive univariate
logit GAMs reuse exact terms; other structures use ordinary prediction.

`cast_run(cache_dir = ...)` caches preparation, selection, fit, CV, evaluation
and refit separately. Keys include data, scientific settings and relevant code;
future scenarios and output paths do not trigger fitting. A split supplied as
`prepared = cast_prepare(...)` is checked against input row indices and values.

Comparison receipts verify model/input content and output hashes. Changed or
damaged artifacts are not silently reused. Choose a new output directory or
`overwrite = TRUE` to replace stale outputs. OS locks prevent simultaneous
writes and release on process termination. Hardware budgets do not change
scientific cache keys or contrast definitions.
